name: Exp_PFE_Extr
summary: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses multiple smoothing methods via the CXMA library and supports configurable money management modes including fixed lot and margin-based sizing. The strategy operates as a zero-lag crossover system on extreme PFE level breaches.
summary_zh: 该EA基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标进行交易，当PFE上穿上限水平时开多仓，下穿下限水平时开空仓。它通过CXMA库支持多种平滑方法，并支持包括固定手数和基于保证金的仓位管理模式。该策略作为零滞后交叉系统在PFE极值突破时运行。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标，PFE衡量价格运动的效率程度，正值表示上升趋势效率高，负值表示下降趋势效率高。入场条件为：当PFE值从下方突破UpLevel(+0.5)时开多仓，当PFE值从上方跌破DnLevel(-0.5)时开空仓，使用SignalBar=1确认交叉突破。出场条件包括：当PFE跌破下限时平多仓，当PFE升破上限时平空仓，同时设有止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数，默认使用固定手数模式。信号仅在NewBar时判断以避免重复交易，但缺乏对现有持仓数量的检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement—positive values indicate high uptrend efficiency and negative values indicate high downtrend efficiency. Entry conditions: open a buy when PFE crosses above UpLevel (+0.5) from below, and open a sell when PFE crosses below DnLevel (-0.5) from above, with SignalBar=1 used to confirm the crossover. Exit conditions include closing long positions when PFE drops below the lower level, closing short positions when PFE rises above the upper level, along with a StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot, defaulting to fixed lot mode. Signals are evaluated only on new bars to avoid redundant trades, but there is no check for existing positions in the same direction, which may lead to duplicate entries.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（保证金/余额/固定手数等）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase parameter, affects JJMA/VIDYA/AMA behavior

pros: 使用PFE指标判断趋势效率，具有数学理论基础而非纯经验指标
支持多种平滑算法（JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA等），可灵活优化信号质量
NewBar机制有效避免同一K线内重复触发信号
提供5种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活度较高
买卖方向可独立开关控制，便于单向交易或对冲策略测试
pros_en: Uses PFE indicator with mathematical foundation for trend efficiency rather than purely empirical signals
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) allowing flexible signal quality optimization
NewBar mechanism effectively prevents duplicate signal triggers within the same bar
Provides 5 position sizing modes offering high flexibility in money management
Buy and sell directions can be independently enabled/disabled, useful for unidirectional or hedging strategy testing
cons: 缺乏同向持仓检查，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓导致过度敞口
止损1000点和止盈2000点偏大，在H4周期下可能承受较大浮亏
没有点差过滤机制，在流动性差或点差扩大时可能不利入场
依赖自定义PFE指标文件，若指标缺失则EA无法初始化
指标数据CopyBuffer仅读取2个值，若指标缓冲区数据不足时处理较为简单
cons_en: Lacks same-direction position check, potentially opening duplicate positions and causing excessive exposure
StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are large, potentially enduring significant drawdowns on H4 timeframe
No spread filter mechanism, may enter at unfavorable prices during low liquidity or widened spreads
Depends on custom PFE indicator file—EA fails to initialize if the indicator is missing
Only reads 2 values from CopyBuffer with minimal error handling when indicator buffer data is insufficient
improvements: 增加同向持仓数量检查，避免重复开仓导致仓位过重
添加点差过滤和时间过滤机制，避免在点差扩大或低流动性时段入场
improvements_en: Add same-direction position count check to prevent duplicate entries and over-concentration of positions
Add spread filter and session time filter to avoid entering during widened spreads or low liquidity periods

risk_points: 缺少同向持仓检查，可能在趋势行情中反复开仓导致风险累积
止损止盈点数较大(1000/2000)，单笔交易风险敞口较高
无点差过滤，高波动时段滑点成本不可控
risk_points_en: Missing same-direction position check may lead to repeated entries during trending markets, accumulating risk
Large SL/TP values (1000/2000 points) result in high per-trade risk exposure
No spread filter means slippage costs are uncontrolled during high volatility periods
